title: A03：只读取已经完成的 RAW 诊断轨迹
context: Claim: The complete A02 diagnostic artifact permits a bounded reading of the fixed seed-0 RAW actions and regrets at updates252..264, with its diagnostic execution provenance retained. Binding MARL structure: systems / information flow; these are four-agent common-history decisions under partial observability, but this read isolates learner exposure and checkpoint phase rather than a multi-agent or residual effect.

options.label: launch as carded
options.consequence: 检查全部十三个固定检查点，不新增学习器曝光，结论限于这一条诊断轨迹。

options.label: do not launch
options.consequence: 保留数据而不解读，原RAW问题继续没有读数。

options.label: revise before launch
options.consequence: 按批注意见调整读取范围，保留原始结果与来源。

dm_reason: 完整数据已经存在，独立命名并披露诊断来源即可避免重复训练和误标旧失败。

packet.question: 是否把已经完整保存的诊断轨迹作为独立命名的A类观察读取，而不再训练？

changes_if_approved.from: 只接受一次未复现故障的技术完成事实
changes_if_approved.to: 保留诊断来源，独立检查原定十三个检查点的RAW动作与后悔值

packet.if_refused: 保留完整原始文件与A02技术结论，不解读轨迹，不新增训练。

evidence_for.quote: One invocation with fault reporting completed and produced the fixed runner's full output before the cap.
evidence_for.why: 原定轨迹已经存在，直接读取即可回答原问题，无需再支付学习器成本。

evidence_against.quote: This is an explicitly outcome-informed reading, selected after A02 completed normally and before its phase metrics were read by the DM.
evidence_against.why: 它不是独立确认，也不能把诊断开关或此前失败的来源隐藏。

uncertainty: 完整性、固定锚点和逐行重算尚待检查。
一条轨迹不能支持残差效果、选出未见数据上的检查点或稳定性结论。

cost.compute: 仅一次本地已有JSON读取，最多30秒；新增环境步、更新、评估均为零。

packet.verdict_text: Recommendation: **(a)**. It answers the already accepted fixed-checkpoint question using existing data, with no new exposure and without rewriting either earlier attempt's identity or branch.
